title: Sibling Set Completeness Check
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familytree:node relationship=sibling
| stats count as sibling_links by family_id
| where sibling_links<2
| sort sibling_links family_id
description: Flags nuclear family groups where sibling relationships look unusually sparse and may be incomplete.
value: Missing siblings can distort migration, naming, and DNA interpretation, so they are worth finding systematically.
implementation: Use `family_id` and relationship labels in `familytree:node`; identify families with suspiciously low sibling linkage.
visualization: Table of families with potentially incomplete sibling sets.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which family groups may still be missing brothers or sisters in the tree.
